nav.viajeTexto: You're building your new reality one day at a time.

home.titulo: Understand what you feel. Discover your patterns.
home.descripcion: Readings created from your birth chart to explore what repeats and move forward with more clarity.
home.alt: A woman reading her Abundance Code portal on her phone at sunset.

planes.descripcion: Purchases are made on our main site. When you're done, come back here and sign in with the Google account for the email you used.

activar.descripcion: Create your account or sign in with the email you used to purchase.
activar.conToken: Your purchase link is included: once you sign in, your access is activated on this account.
activar.sinToken: Whether you sign in by email or with Google, you reach the same account: the one for the email you purchased with.
activar.errorGoogle: We couldn't reach Google. Check your connection and try again.

errores.cancelado: You cancelled the sign-in. You can try again whenever you like.
errores.sin_codigo: That access link is no longer valid. Sign in with Google from here.
errores.sesion: We couldn't complete your session. Please try again.

confirmar.titulo: Link the purchase to this account?
confirmar.texto: You are signed in as {correo}. If you link the purchase here, this will be your portal.
confirmar.no: No, sign in with another account

correo.enviado: We sent a sign-in link to {correo}. Open it in this same browser to sign in.
correo.error: We could not send the link. Check the email and try again.

vincular.textoCaducado: Access links are valid for 30 days. Ask for a new one and you're back in right away — your purchase is still there.
vincular.textoInactivo: We found your purchase, but the subscription isn't active right now.
vincular.textoSinCompra: There's no purchase registered with this email:
vincular.otroCorreo: If you bought with a different email, sign in with the Google account for that email.
vincular.soporte: Bought and still seeing this? Write to us at <enlace>{correo}</enlace> with the email you paid with and we'll link it by hand.

suscripcion.mensaje: Your subscription isn't active right now. Your base reading and your birth chart are still yours and will stay here. Personal guidance and daily activations need an active subscription.

cuenta.descripcion: Manage your information and the state of your portal.
cuenta.incluye: Your subscription includes your base reading, your portrait, each day's activation and {consultas} guide questions a day. If it is ever cancelled, your base reading and your natal chart remain yours.
cuenta.portalError: We couldn't open your subscription settings right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
cuenta.portalSinCompra: We couldn't find a subscription linked to your account.
cuenta.portalSinStripe: Your access isn't linked to a Stripe subscription, so there's nothing to manage here. If you think that's a mistake, write to us.
cuenta.pagoPendiente: Your last payment didn't go through. You keep your access while it's sorted out: update your card from “Manage my subscription”, not from the pricing page, or you'd be charged a new entry fee.
cuenta.incluyeCortesia: You have courtesy access: the same as a subscription —base reading, portrait, daily activation and {consultas} guide questions a day— with no payment or renewal to manage.
cuenta.nombreGuardado: Your name has been saved. Since your birth details did not change, your chart and readings stay the same.

portal.subtitulo: This is your private space for reading, clarity and alignment.
portal.completaDatosTexto: Without date, time and place we can't calculate your chart. It's the only thing we need from you.
portal.trasDatos: Available once you complete your birth details.
portal.trasDatosCorto: Available once you complete your details.
portal.activacionTexto: A daily energetic activation to raise your frequency and align your actions.
portal.guiaTexto: Ask me about your decisions, blocks or the signs you're receiving.
portal.cierre: ✦ It's not about changing who you are, but about remembering your code and aligning with it. ✦
portal.faltaLectura: Your base reading was never written
portal.faltaLecturaTexto: Your chart is calculated, but the interpretation did not finish. Nothing is lost: it takes a minute to write and it is yours for good.
portal.lecturaPersonalTexto: The interpretation written from your chart: your energy, your patterns, your blocks and a first step.

areas.subtitulo: Where each one lives in your chart. Tap one to ask your guide.

preguntas.abundancia: What pattern keeps repeating in my relationship with money?
preguntas.decisiones: What decision am I avoiding, and what is really holding me back?
preguntas.proposito: Where does my chart point when I think about my purpose?
preguntas.bloqueos: What inner block keeps coming back, and where does it come from?
preguntas.relaciones: What pattern do I repeat in my relationships?

lectura.descripcion: An interpretation written from your Natal Code to help you understand your patterns, blocks and areas of expansion.
lectura.cartaPendiente: Your chart is not calculated yet. It calculates itself as soon as you complete your birth details; if you already did, come back in a moment.
lectura.noGenerada: Your reading isn't written yet. These are the sections it will have. If you just completed your details, it takes about a minute — come back in a moment.

activacion.descripcion: A sign to watch for today, read from your Personal Code.
activacion.noPreparada: We couldn't prepare today's activation. Try again in a few minutes. These are the parts it will have.
activacion.sinCarta: Your activation will arrive as soon as your chart is calculated. These are the parts it will have.
activacion.reglaDia: The day changes at midnight in {ciudad} time, your place of birth; the guide's daily question counter changes at the same time.

guia.descripcion: Consult your Personal Code whenever you need clarity about a decision, a block or a sign you're living through.
guia.intro: Sometimes you do not need more information. Sometimes what you need is clarity. Your Personal Code has answers. Ask from intention and receive the guidance your soul is ready to hear.

historial.nota: Everything you have asked and what your guide answered. Re-reading them does not use up a question.
historial.vacio: You have not asked anything yet. When you do, it will be kept here with its answer.
historial.sinRespuesta: This question was left without an answer.

patrones.descripcion: Recognising cycles, tensions and personal strengths.

bloqueos.descripcion: Understanding what may be limiting your expansion.

guia.descripcion: Putting together the reading written for you.

generando.errorTexto: Try again in a few minutes; your details and your chart are saved.
generando.lista: Your reading is ready. Opening it…
generando.esperando: Interpreting your chart. It's the longest of the {total} steps: it can take a minute, don't close this page.
generando.descripcion: We're calculating your chart and writing your interpretation. It takes about a minute.
generando.cabeceraTexto: Connecting your birth details with the patterns that will shape your personal guidance.

guia_form.pregunta: What do you need to understand today?
guia_form.restantes: You have {n} of {total} questions left today. The limit is daily and the same for every account, paid or not; re-reading a saved answer does not use one.
guia_form.agotadas: You have used your {total} questions for today. They come back tomorrow; meanwhile you can re-read the previous ones below.
guia_form.aviso: Personal Guidance is designed for personal reflection and inner clarity. It does not replace professional medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.

sugeridas.bloqueo: What block do I need to look at now?
sugeridas.patron: What abundance pattern am I repeating?
sugeridas.senal: What sign should I watch for this week?
sugeridas.energia: What energy do I need to activate today?

carta.sinHoraAviso: Your chart was calculated without a birth time, so it shows the planets but not the houses, the Ascendant or the Midheaven. If you ever find it out, you can add it and the chart is recalculated.
carta.noCalculada: We could not calculate your chart. It usually means the date, time or place of birth do not fit together. Check them and we will try again.

retrato.titulo: Who you are, according to your chart
retrato.descripcion: A walk through your chart piece by piece: what each planet does in the way you are, think, love and act.
retrato.pendiente: We are writing your portrait from your chart. It takes about a minute the first time; after that it stays saved.
retrato.noDisponible: We couldn't prepare your portrait right now. Come back in a while and we'll try again.
retrato.requiereSuscripcion: Your portrait is written with an active subscription. Your chart and your base reading remain yours.

titulos.venus: How you love and what you value
titulos.marte: How you act and face conflict

cielo.titulo: What is touching your chart today

explicacion.conjuncion: Today {mueve} meets {tuyo}: that theme takes the front seat.
explicacion.sextil: Today {mueve} and {tuyo} find an open door: it is there, but you have to walk through it.
explicacion.cuadratura: Today you might feel tension between {mueve} and {tuyo}: something asks for an adjustment.
explicacion.trigono: Today {mueve} and {tuyo} fit together: that comes without effort.
explicacion.oposicion: Today {mueve} and {tuyo} pull in opposite directions: the day asks for balance.

mueve.mercurio: what is being thought and said today

cielo.sinAspectos: No planet comes close to a point in your chart today. A quiet backdrop: whatever moves, moves from within.
cielo.pie: Calculated from today's real sky against your birth chart.

dominante.fuego: Fire predominates in your chart: drive, enthusiasm and the urge to begin weigh most in how you are.
dominante.tierra: Earth predominates in your chart: the practical, the tangible and what lasts weigh most in how you are.
dominante.aire: Air predominates in your chart: ideas, words and connection with others weigh most in how you are.
dominante.agua: Water predominates in your chart: emotion, intuition and memory weigh most in how you are.

ausente.fuego: There is no planet in fire: drive and enthusiasm are not given to you; you build them.
ausente.tierra: There is no planet in earth: the practical and what lasts are not given to you; you build them.
ausente.aire: There is no planet in air: the distance to think and the words are not given to you; you build them.
ausente.agua: There is no planet in water: the connection with what you feel is not given to you; you build it.

equilibrio.repartido: Your chart spreads its weight: no element rules the others.

tabla.leyenda: Planetary positions of the birth chart

rueda.descripcionExacta: Astrological wheel with the twelve signs, {planetas} planets, the twelve houses, the Ascendant and the Midheaven. Below is a table with the same positions in text.
rueda.descripcionParcial: Astrological wheel with the twelve signs and {planetas} planets, without houses, because the birth time is unknown. Below is a table with the same positions in text.
rueda.pieParcial: This chart was calculated without a birth time. The planet positions are correct, but it does not include houses, Ascendant or Midheaven: those depend on the exact time.

onboarding.descripcion: This is what we use to calculate your birth chart. Time and place matter as much as the date: they determine the exact position of the sky above you.
onboarding.horaDesconocida: I don't know my birth time
onboarding.avisoSinHora: We will calculate your chart using local noon. The planet positions will be correct, but we will not be able to include the houses, the ascendant or the midheaven: those depend on the exact time. Your chart will say so.
onboarding.ciudadPlaceholder: Start typing and pick from the list

editar.descripcion: Review and change what needs changing. What you see is what is saved right now.
editar.aviso: If you change the date, time or place, your chart is recalculated and your base reading and portrait are written again over the new chart. The previous versions are not lost: they are kept and you can re-read them in your reading and your chart. Your guide questions are preserved. If you only change the name, nothing is rewritten.
editar.cancelar: Back to My Account without changing anything

versiones.nota: They were set aside when you corrected your birth details. They are kept exactly as they were written.

descarga.confirmacion: Your chart was saved as {archivo}. Look for it in your downloads folder.
descarga.error: We could not generate the image. Please try again.
